answer: Sybil resistance: each identity bonds a ferrous stake (small POA deposit) that burns on incoherent answers. Peers cross-check an agent's new answer against its on-chain history across the canyon of past epochs. A cloned bot cannot mirror a real model's evolving commitments, so its slip is a whisper the jury detects. Attacking at scale means funding N stakes plus N coherent traces, making marginal cost linear with bot count.
